description: This file defines a PHP class 'Topic' within the OpenCart admin controller namespace. The class contains an 'add' method that manages tasks related to catalog topics, including clearing old data, listing topics, and fetching topic info for each topic retrieved from the 'cms/topic' model.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller class for managing catalog topic related tasks in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Generates tasks related to catalog topics, including clearing old data, listing all topics, and retrieving detailed info for each topic.
